name: Honmei Gisou
source: One day, as Valentine's Day was approaching, Muroi was stopped by Ootaka, a friend from the same class. Ootaka asked Muroi to prepare a honmei chocolate for Valentine's Day...
translation: One day, as Valentine's Day was approaching, Muroi was stopped by Ootaka, a friend from the same class. Ootaka asked Muroi to prepare a honmei chocolate for Valentine's Day...
